mostWorthwhile.text: Building the mineralised bone and adding its cells and blood supply was most worthwhile. The planned cutaways connect material properties with the fact that bone is living tissue.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells to the framework felt somewhat repetitive after the lineage construction, although the cell channels added useful detail.

surprise.text: The bone-lineage picture distinguished matrix-producing osteoblasts from osteocytes embedded in the matrix, making the relationship between the cells and mature bone clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave the combinations clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose to continue to see how the constructed skeleton connects to movement, because the bone and joint constructions made the relationship between structure and function interesting.
